about.intro: I am a technology consultant and developer building my career around the Microsoft ecosystem, with a focus on Dynamics 365 CRM and the Power Platform. I enjoy transforming complex business needs into practical, elegant digital experiences that help people work smarter.
about.story: Beyond my professional role, I enjoy exploring startup ideas and side projects that combine technology, creativity, and entrepreneurship. I am driven by curiosity and continuous learning, always seeking projects that align with my values, technical expertise, and long-term aspirations.

highlights: Consulting across Brazil, the US, Europe, and global enterprises
